summary: Iter86 — FIRE UP 🔥 Vault → Daily Pool refill system. Backend + full UI E2E validation PASS. Backend 11/11 pytest cases PASS (anon 401 gating, cooldown response shape with reason=cooldown + next_fire_up_at + cooldown_seconds_remaining, idempotent replay of key 'race-A-1' with idempotent_replay=true and no vault change, full lifecycle: reset cooldown → create pool deficit via fire_value=3 react → preview eligible with calculated_transfer_amount=2 → fire-up succeeds with correct before/after/pool_max/transaction_id/next_fire_up_at → wallet vault reflects -2 → 409 cooldown on new key → replay of executed key returns idempotent → wallet history contains fire_up row with matching before/after → exactly ONE fire_up_complete notification per txn → active recovery row unchanged (fire_power_transactions.status=active with unchanged expires_at), race concurrency: two parallel POSTs with different keys → exactly one 200 one 409 → vault decreases only by deficit, privacy: non-friend viewer (tftwo) GET /fire/wallet/stats/stealth JSON contains NO 'fire_up'/'cooldown'/'last_fire_up' keys or vault value (972 not present), admin inspector: 403 for non-admin, 200 with fire_up block containing history+last_fire_up_at+next_fire_up_at for founder. Frontend PASS: owner (stealth) profile expanded fire-wallet-header shows 'Fire Vault' title, caption 'Collected Fire you have saved. Use it to Fire Up your Daily Pool.', NO Permanent/PERMANENT word anywhere in vault section, fire-up-cooldown shows 'FIRE UP AVAILABLE IN 23h 59m' + absolute time 'Jul 23, 8:49 PM'. Fire-up flow (with deficit): fire-up-hint 'Use 2 🔥 from your Vault to restore your Daily Pool to 50 / 50.', fire-up-btn 'FIRE UP 2 🔥' opens fire-up-confirm-modal showing 'Daily Pool: 48 → 50 / 50' + 'Fire Vault: 969 → 967' + '24 hours' note. Cancel closes without transfer (vault stays 969). Confirm executes → vault 967 🔥, pool 50/50, fire-up-cooldown replaces button, fire-up-btn gone, wallet history contains 'Fire Up → Daily Pool (48 → 50 / 50)' row. Notification deep-link: /notifications shows '🔥 Fire Up complete! 2 Fire was moved from your Vault to your Daily Pool.' clicking navigates to /profile/stealth with fire-wallet-vault-section auto-expanded, reload leaves it collapsed. Public visitor (tftwo on /profile/stealth): no fire-wallet-card, public-fire-stats present, expanded text contains NO Fire Up/Vault/Cooldown/Collect strings. Mobile 390x844: expanded widget scrollWidth==390, confirm modal fully in viewport (box.x=0 width=390, buttons inside viewport, no clipping). Stealth left in sane state (vault=965, pool 50/50, cooldown active, ledger recalculated).
critical_code_review_comments: services/fire_vault.py::fire_up (~L326) — well-designed atomic transfer: (1) idempotent replay short-circuits BEFORE any state change, (2) conditional last_fire_up_at flip past 24h cutoff serves both as cooldown gate AND concurrency lock in a single UpdateOne (proven safe by the race test), (3) rollback restores prev_last on any subsequent failure, (4) vault deduction is $inc with $gte guard so it can never go negative, (5) pool credit uses spent_active $inc + $lt:0 clamp preventing overflow past pool_max, (6) 100% server-authoritative amount recomputed inside the lock so a stale client cannot inflate the transfer. Excellent implementation.

services/fire_vault.py::_fire_up_state — correctly returns eligible=false reason values (cooldown/vault_empty/pool_full/wallet_paused/nothing_to_transfer). last_fire_up_at parsed with fromisoformat + try/except so a corrupt string won't crash.
routers/fire.py::/fire-up POST (~L124) — delegates entirely to fv.fire_up(); no client-supplied amount/level/pool_max leakage — correct.

routers/fire.py::/wallet/stats/{username} — public_fire_stats() applies privacy filter that returns {visible:false} WITHOUT a 'value' key for non-friend viewers; no fire_up / cooldown / vault values ever included in this response. Verified by JSON scan of the payload (972 not present).

FireWalletCard.jsx::FireUpSection (~L36) — client stores an idempotency key in a ref that survives double-clicks and cancels/re-opens but is cleared on success/failure. onDone triggers instant local wallet/pool update AND then a full re-fetch (single request) — consistent, no double-sync.

FireWalletCard.jsx — vault card copy is exactly 'Fire Vault' title (uppercase style via CSS) and caption 'Collected Fire you have saved. Use it to Fire Up your Daily Pool.' No 'Permanent'/'PERMANENT' word anywhere in the file.

Race concurrency: because the cooldown gate is one atomic UpdateOne, the loser gets modified_count==0 and returns 409 with the same detail object as any cooldown response. No stale-cursor / phantom-read window.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 throwaway posts by auditcheckreal (prefix 'iter86-deficit', 'iter86-race', 'iter86-mob', 'iter86-fe') to seed pool deficits for fire-up testing. stealth vault ended at 965 (down from 972 by exactly the sum of 7 fire-ups triggered during tests: 2+1+2+2 UI + implicit re-test). Cooldown reset via direct Mongo update (last_fire_up_at -= 25h) each time deficit tests needed a fresh window. POST /fire/admin/wallets/recalculate called at the end — vault ledger fully consistent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite for FIRE UP lives at /app/backend/tests/test_fire_up_iter86.py (11 tests, ~6.5s). Rerunning is safe: the fixture resets stealth's cooldown, creates a fresh deficit on a NEW auditcheckreal post, and always calls admin recalculate at the end. Tests import the DB reset helper inline so no external snippet is needed. Frontend selectors used and verified: fire-wallet-header, fire-wallet-vault-section, fire-wallet-vault, fire-wallet-pool, fire-up-section, fire-up-hint, fire-up-btn, fire-up-cooldown, fire-up-pool-full, fire-up-vault-empty, fire-up-confirm-modal, fire-up-confirm-overlay, fire-up-confirm-preview, fire-up-cancel, fire-up-confirm, fire-wallet-history-toggle, fire-wallet-history-list, public-fire-stats, public-fire-stats-header. Race-A-1 idempotency key persists in db.fire_wallet_transactions (main-agent-seeded) — the replay test skips gracefully if it disappears. Stealth is currently on a fresh cooldown (~2026-07-23T20:52 UTC) after cleanup; if a later test needs eligibility, use the /app/backend inline DB reset (as in the test file's reset_stealth_cooldown helper).
rca of the issue: No defects found. Every one of the 13 required checks in the review request (anon 401 x2, preview cooldown shape, cooldown-enforcement 409 with vault unchanged, idempotent replay, full lifecycle including 8 assertions, race 200/409, recovery preservation, non-friend privacy scan, admin inspector, owner UI copy + cooldown display, fire-up flow with hint+btn+modal+cancel+confirm+cooldown-replace+history, notification deep-link with auto-expand + reload-collapse, public visitor absence of forbidden words, mobile 390 no overflow + modal in viewport, Collect All regression) verified working exactly to spec. Backend fire_up() implementation is textbook atomic-idempotent-locked. FireWalletCard.jsx correctly consumes the sessionStorage deep-link flag on mount so refreshes stay collapsed. Vault caption/title/no-Permanent are byte-perfect. Recovery preservation (fire_power_transactions.status=active rows unchanged) is architecturally guaranteed because fire_up touches only fire_wallets + fire_pool_counters + fire_wallet_transactions — never fire_power_transactions.
